d:
After my travel friends Brayden and Anna left for their own countries, I continued exploring Brazil all by myself. My next destination was Belo Horizonte, a city that is often overlooked by international tourists compared to Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo.
I spent my time walking around the city, exploring local streets, meeting amazing people, and experiencing everyday Brazilian life. Honestly, Belo Horizonte was a wonderful surprise, and I had such a great time discovering this side of Brazil.
